blind.description: A decorative oval metal serving platter with a shallow central basin, a raised beaded rim, and two curved loop handles on opposing ends. The material is a slightly aged, polished brass or gold-toned metal with smooth, continuous surfaces and realistic metallic reflections.
blind.from_above: An oval tray oriented horizontally with a beaded decorative rim and two small loop handles projecting symmetrically from the left and right ends.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely low, under 2 inches (5 cm) tall, spanning roughly 1.5 feet (45 cm) in length and about 1 foot (30 cm) in width compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure.

notes: Aged brass/gold finish rather than silver, but cleanly represents an empty oval platter
